demos.title: Tidal Sanctuary
demos.description: From a sunlit cove to swaying kelp, a forgotten wreck, and a luminous underwater grotto. One continuous world, made entirely from code.
demos.requirements: Requires a browser with WebGPU · keyboard and mouse recommended

demos.title: The Mist
demos.description: A mist-filled street, procedural lighting and synthesized sound in a single 6.3 KB HTML file.

demos.title: Arcane Chant 3D
demos.description: Speak Thai incantations and shout Fireball in a 3D mystic arena, upgrading through 9 grimoire volumes from 10m slow chants to instant 20m solar blasts.
demos.requirements: Requires WebGL2 · Microphone (Chrome / Edge / Safari) or keyboard fallback
